verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a physical GPU that the buyer owns and installs in their own machine. Self-hosting is a deployment axis for hosted software or services, so asking whether this card can be self-hosted is a category error. The evidence about running PyTorch, vLLM or llama.cpp locally describes workloads running on the card, not self-hosting the product itself, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
